input_method.latency_scope: Serial command round trip includes transport/dispatch overhead; not physical touch latency
input_method.immediate_input_observation: The initial music-page check typed before background loading finished: keys responded but candidates were not ready at the sampled instant. Pending Pinyin was retained. Later candidate readiness and confirmation passed.

limits: Only CSI was tested; USB camera was not connected.
Physical camera exit was tested by tapping the return area; other gesture directions retain host verification only.
Tests used hardware reset; a physical power-disconnect cold start was not verified.
BLE identity was recorded; new pairing and reboot persistence were outside this input/camera test.
The initial dictionary preparation remains asynchronous and takes a few seconds; Chinese candidates appear after it finishes.
archive_note: The firmware ZIP contains the original pre-flash build-time verification snapshot. This report records subsequent board acceptance.
publication_note: Physical results apply to the frozen 7fc37780 image. Fixes are merged onto newer upstream source without replacing unrelated JBox work; merged-source host validation is recorded separately.
